mapper.select: SELECT c.open_app_id AS appId, ac.auth_protocol AS authProtocol, ac.logout_notify_url AS logoutNotifyUrl, c.access_key AS accessKey, c.secret_key AS secretKey, c.sign_algorithm AS signAlgorithm, c.need_sign AS needSign FROM tab_app_auth_config ac INNER JOIN tab_app_config c ON c.app_id = ac.app_id WHERE ac.auth_protocol != 'NONE'
